messages:
Alex (AE): Quick heads-up — AcmeCo POC: 2-week timeline, wants hosted API keys initially but may request Dedicated pool and VPC by week 2. They need a clear runbook for onboarding + security questionnaire answers. Who can own the provisioning path?
Maria (SE): I can lead the POC onboarding. Need a few things: estimated qps, model family (opt vs gpt), and whether they need embeddings.
Alex (AE): Customer expects ~50 rps peak, mostly chat gen, and wants embeddings for search later. They prefer open models.
Devon (Platform Eng): For 50 rps we can start with Hosted API + rate-limits. Dedicated sizing: 1x 8-GPU pool should be fine if we pin a medium-sized model. If they move to VPC/private we need ticket + infra lead.
Samir (Security): FYI AcmeCO's procurement will require SOC2 scope, KMS integration, and an export control question. I'll prep template answers. Also: data residency — they insist EU-only.
Maria (SE): Actionable runbook suggestion (short):
1) Create trial org + generate API keys (Hosted)
2) Provide example app + CORS-safe snippet
3) Add usage alert thresholds and cost guardrails
4) If Dedicated requested, open infra intake + estimate GPUs
Devon (Platform Eng): Snippet to generate a hosted key (internal CLI):
```
# create sandbox org and key
rwctl org create --name "acmeco-poc" --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org acmeco-poc --note "POC key - do not use for prod"
```
Maria (SE): Quick checklist I will send to customer:
- Confirm EU-only region
- Provide contact for ops + security
- Confirm allowed data types (PII ok/no)
- Agree retention window (default 30d)
Alex (AE): Procurement Q: what pricing do we give for 2-week POC to avoid surprises? Need a callout for billing contacts.
Devon (Platform Eng): Recommend capped usage on trial org + pre-approved overage policy. For Dedicated, give a provisional monthly commit estimate, note 7-14 day lead time for GPU allocation.
Samir (Security): I'll attach our short security FAQ for POCs (SOC2 link, KMS pattern, VPN options). For the security questionnaire — please forward the doc; I'll drop redlines in 24h.
deploy-bot: env acmeco-poc created by Maria (SE) — hosted keys pending.
Maria (SE): I'll provision the hosted keys and test a simple chat flow against EU region, then share the quickstart repo link.
Alex (AE): Perfect — Maria owns initial provisioning, Samir will handle sec answers, Devon will advise on Dedicated sizing. I'll schedule a kickoff with AcmeCo tomorrow. :thumbsup:
